Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery

time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. specification mentioned in document. • The bidder should have to submit the PAN Card. • The bidder should have to submit the GST Certificate. • The bidder should have to submit the latest GST clearance certificate. • The bidder should have to submit the Income Tax return for last 3 years. • Undertaking for non-blacklisting on company letterhead. • Bidder have to submit the certificate related to health and safety management. • Bidder have to submit the certificate related to environmental management. • Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents in the Techni cal Bid. • After placement of supply order, a committee shall be constituted at the unit level headed by Gazetted o fficer to certify that the supplied FIREWOOD is as per the specification mentioned in bid document. • The committee shall take random samples of each lot for quality check and inspected them and the the l ots against which satisfactory report is received shall be taken on stock. • 100% payment will be made on submission of invoices after successful completion. •The bidder should quote the rate inclusive of all taxes and other charges. •The supplier will store the stock in sufficient quantity at any suitable location nearest to unit. • The successful supplier shall have to make the supplies to the department within 15 days or within the period stipulated in supply order, failing which penalty @ 2% against indented supplies shall be imp osed per day for belated period. • Income tax/ Service tax/ GST as applicable shall be deducted at the source from the payment to the firm/ party. • The rates should be quoted for this Unit, Including loading. • There will be no compromise on quality of the products. • The authority reserves the right to accept or reject any or all the bids without assigning any reason there of at any stage. • Bidder must deliver REJECTION WOOD to the locations specified by the consignee at their own expense. No separate freight will be provided. • All legal proceedings arising out of any dispute between parties shall have to be instituted in the courts s ituated in Srinagar jurisdiction only. Note: The documents provided/uploaded by sellers must be clear and readable otherwise they will be disq ualified. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC
